roi.profile.sql: select campaign_id, sum(impressions) as impressions from analytics.marketing.campaign_daily group by 1 having sum(impressions) = 0
roi.profile.summary: 3 of 412 campaigns have had zero impressions since 2026-09-02. No tagged or financial object downstream. Query cost: fractions of a cent.

roi.lineage.summary: OBJECT_DEPENDENCIES returns two marketing dashboard views (CAMPAIGN_DASHBOARD, ROI_TREND). Nothing tagged, nothing financial.

roi.clone.summary: Cloned ANALYTICS.MARKETING, ran the changed model and eleven dependents against production volume. Assertions pass. Row-count delta is exactly the three campaigns now returning null ROI instead of failing the run.

pii.profile.sql: select count(*) as exposed_rows from analytics.player.player_segments where email is not null or date_of_birth is not null
pii.profile.summary: 184,412 rows in PLAYER_SEGMENTS currently carry EMAIL or DATE_OF_BIRTH. Columns first appeared after a source-table release two days ago.

pii.access_history.sql: select user_name, role_name, query_start_time from snowflake.account_usage.access_history where objects_modified is not null
pii.access_history.summary: ACCESS_HISTORY: four roles ran nine queries touching EMAIL or DATE_OF_BIRTH over 41 hours. Converts “we had an exposure” into a reportable set of facts.

pii.lineage.summary: OBJECT_DEPENDENCIES finds the same PII flowing into ANALYTICS.PLAYER.PLAYER_LOOKALIKE — a hand-created view that is not in the SQL repo and that the proposed patch does not touch.

pii.clone.summary: Clone run is green: EMAIL and DATE_OF_BIRTH are gone from the proposed model and nothing in the SQL repo breaks. Green is why the next stage matters — materialized rows and PLAYER_LOOKALIKE are still exposed.

ggr.profile.sql: select gaming_day, filed_ggr, slot_ggr, filed_ggr - slot_ggr as delta from finance.recon.daily_ggr_vs_slot where abs(filed_ggr - slot_ggr) > 0
ggr.profile.summary: Three gaming days off, all high overnight volume. $41,280 moved across the midnight boundary in the last 30 days. Reading is always allowed — the dossier is specific because this stage ran.

ggr.lineage.summary: OBJECT_DEPENDENCIES: this object feeds ANALYTICS.REGULATORY.NGCB_MONTHLY_REVENUE and two financial marts used in external reporting. The blast radius is a filing, not a dashboard.
